about: The recorded classes of this notebook's objects, read by tools/claim_resemblance.py: for a new claim (or a next attempt's text) whose words name an object of a class, it lists this notebook's proved claims whose hypothesis (the summary's first colon-ended segment that quantifies an object, up to the first word that opens a conclusion) takes the class or one containing it. 'object' and 'hypothesis' are case-blind regular expressions; 'within' names the classes containing this one, whose bounds apply to its members. An optional 'conclusion' keeps a class's listing to claims whose summary concludes that kind of bound (here a discrepancy bound, |sum_i g(X_i) - N int g| or |D(g)| and the like).
